subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood & Aurora Health
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@aurorahealth.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood & Aurora Health

Hi Samir / Lena —

Great to speak with you both earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery call:

- Scope: Aurora Health is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing workflows. You mentioned HIPAA applicability and a likely need for a BAA.
- Compliance posture we need to validate: SOC 2 (Type II preferred), HIPAA controls, encryption and access control, data residency.
- Next step: We typically kick off a SIG/CAIQ assessment for in-depth coverage. I attached our SIG_Assessment_Template.xlsx and a short security overview.

Can you confirm the following so we can route internally and prioritize:
1) Primary POC for security questionnaire (name/email).
2) Desired timeline for completion — we suggested EOD 2027-06-25 but can adjust.
3) Is a redacted SOC 2 Type II report available, or would a Type I / bridge letter be the current artifact?
4) Any third-party processors or contractors that should be called out in the SIG?

Who will own technical questions vs legal/compliance items on your side? On our side: Alex will handle architecture/kernal/technical controls questions; Marissa will own contract/BAA details.

Attachments:
- SIG_Assessment_Template.xlsx (please fill the spreadsheet where you can; prioritize: Security Program, Data Protection, Access Control, Encryption)
- Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (shorter info for procurement)

We can also provide a draft BAA if you confirm HIPAA applies — I'm attaching a draft here for your review.

If it helps, we can take responsibility for filling in the vendor side of the SIG and have you verify, or you can complete directly — whichever is easier.

Thanks — looking forward to your answers and the POC.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | High-performance inference for production LLMs

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@aurorahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurorahealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood & Aurora Health

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the summary and the template. A few quick clarifying questions before we get the questionnaire routed:

1) For the SIG level, do you need SIG-L3 answers? Would SIG-L2 be acceptable for initial review?
2) When you mention encryption, are you asking for encryption at rest only, or encryption in transit + key management details? We can provide both, but want to scope properly.
3) SOC: we currently have a SOC 2 Type I (2026) and are expecting Type II in Q4 2027. Is Type I sufficient for initial security review?
4) Is there a preferred format for returning the spreadsheet (xlsx vs secure portal upload)?

We have procurement leads who will also want to review the security overview. Procurement asked whether you can provide a redacted SOC report or an attestation letter instead of the full report.

I'll confirm the internal POC tomorrow — likely going to be our security manager, Karen Hsu (cc: not on this thread yet).

Best,
Samir Gupta
Director, Digital Platforms
Aurora Health
samir.gupta@aurorahealth.com
(206) 555-0199

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@aurorahealth.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood & Aurora Health

Hi Samir — thanks, these are great clarifying questions. Answers inline below and next steps.

1) SIG level: SIG-L3 is ideal for a full technical assessment. SIG-L2 is acceptable for initial procurement review if you need a lighter lift; please flag any L3 items you cannot answer and we can follow up.

2) Encryption: please provide both in-transit and at-rest details. For key management, high-level detail on where keys are stored and whether you use a KMS/HSM is sufficient at first — we can drill to specifics if needed.

3) SOC: Type II is preferred, but a current Type I + a documented roadmap to Type II is acceptable for initial evaluation. Procurement typically asks for a redacted report or letter of attestation — we can accept either.

4) Format: xlsx is fine by email. If you prefer, we also accept uploads to a secure intake portal (we can send an invite).

Attachments included: BAA_Draft_Redwood.docx (draft BAA for your legal team), updated SIG_Assessment_Template.xlsx (we pre-filled a few vendor items to speed this up), Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf

Internal routing on our side:
- Alex Martinez (cc) will handle technical follow-ups (architecture, encryption, deployment topology).
- Marissa Cole (cc) will handle contract/BAA and any procurement/legal questions.

Proposed timeline:
- If you can provide an initial pass by 2027-06-28 that would work for our internal review, otherwise let us know a timeline that fits your procurement calendar.

If it helps, we can do a short follow-up call next week to walk through the SIG template and reduce back-and-forth — Alex can join to cover the technical items.

Thanks again — we appreciate you coordinating with your security/procurement team.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurorahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@aurorahealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood & Aurora Health

Hi Camila / Team —

Thanks for the details and the pre-filled template — that helps. A couple notes from procurement/security standpoint: 

- Timeline: our team is slightly overloaded this week; a completion date of 2027-06-28 is tight but feasible if we prioritize. If not, we will aim for 2027-07-05. Can you confirm which items are must-haves vs nice-to-have for the initial sign-off?
- SOC: procurement would prefer a redacted SOC 2 Type II if available, otherwise a Type I plus an attestation/roadmap is ok. Can Redwood provide a redacted copy or an attestation letter?
- Contact: I will add Karen Hsu (karen.hsu@aurorahealth.com) to the thread as our security POC; she will handle most of the SIG responses.

We will start filling the xlsx and loop Karen today. If there's a chance to do a 30-min walkthrough next week, that would be helpful — propose 2027-06-29 or 2027-06-30 mornings PST.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
